remarks: Come take a look at this beautifully newly renovated bungalow/cottage in Norwalk, CT! This fully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath home is truly move-in ready and waiting for its next owner.  Thoughtfully renovated with attention to detail throughout, this home blends charm and modern updates seamlessly. From the finishes to the layout, every space has been refreshed to offer comfort and functionality.  Situated on a desirable corner lot, the property features a private driveway with room for multiple vehicles - rare and valuable in this location.  Conveniently located just minutes from the South Norwalk (SoNo) Train Station, SoNo's popular restaurants, shopping, and entertainment. Easy access to major highways and bus routes makes commuting simple and efficient.  All you have to do is move in and enjoy everything this home and location have to offer!
